name: Fruitful Multiplication
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 2, druid 2, ranger 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (an egg, a piece of placenta, and herbs worth 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target a willing creature touched
Duration Until discharged, up to 1 month
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You bless the subject with increased fertility. If the subject becomes pregnant (if female) or sires a child (if male) within the next month, there is one additional offspring in addition to the normal results of the union. This spell does not overcome sterility or racial incompatibility, and cannot increase the number of additional offspring by more than one per union.

Creatures with Intelligence 2 or lower are always considered willing.
